title: KestrelCare Rental Car Reimbursement: Nights, Rate and Receipt Window
content:
## 1. The repair order and the authorization read

The repair order a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts rental reimbursement is figured on is the one named on the holder's latest limited warranty decision, and the plan's approved authorization it reads is the one on that same repair order; while that repair order carries no approved authorization, no rental reimbursement is due on it.

## 2. The amount

A rental car reimbursement on an approved repair order pays the plan's rental per day for each night counted on the repair order, the nights being counted in calendar days from the failure date on the plan's approved authorization of that repair order to the date of that authorization. The nights counted are capped at the plan's rental maximum days per visit. The reimbursement is the capped nights times the plan's rental per day, rounded to the cent, and is never below zero.

| Quantity | Read from |
|---|---|
| Failure date | the plan's approved claim decision entry on the repair order |
| Authorization date | the date of that approved claim decision entry |
| Rental per day, rental maximum days per visit | the plan's coverage level |

## 3. Receipts and once per repair order

Because a rental on such a repair can be reimbursed under the plan only once the plan has decided the repair order, the rental receipts are accepted within the plan's benefit receipt submission days counted in calendar days from the date of the plan's approved authorization of that repair order, and the rental is reimbursed once per repair order. A rental claimed after that period, or on a repair order that already carries a rental car reimbursement entry, is reimbursed nothing.

Towing and trip interruption receipts remain due within the benefit receipt submission days after the repair is completed, the release of the vehicle by the repairing facility marking that completion, and each of those benefit types is reimbursed once per repair order.

## Worked figures (hypothetical plan: rental per day 40.00, rental maximum 5 days, receipts within 30 days)

| Failure date on the authorization | Authorization date | Nights counted | Nights after the cap | Reimbursement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 September | 6 September | 4 | 4 | 160.00 |
| 2 September | 11 September | 9 | 5 | 200.00 |

With the authorization dated 6 September, a rental claimed on 6 October (day 30) is within the receipt period; one claimed on 7 October is not.
